purpose: establish a full-budget, capacity-matched learnable baseline for subsequent PSCR method comparison
precondition: G0 pilot produced non-zero bounded service value in two of three independent training seeds
interface: public role-conditioned service intents with a deterministic shared 3DOF execution controller
interpretation_boundary: This is the matched plain-MAPPO baseline for task calibration. It does not establish the efficacy of a PSCR-specific mechanism.
